_readme: EXAMPLE: RAK3172 (RUI3 / Cayenne) sensor. Not read by the service; copy from here.
1. Copy the block under "devices" into the "devices" object of server/python/devices.json.
2. Replace the devEUI key (lowercase, 16 hex chars) with your sensor's, and change name and ntfy_topic.
3. "family" must be the ChirpStack device-profile name: RAK3172 (aliases rui3, cayenne also work).
4. application_id is the ChirpStack application UUID, needed only for downlinks; the service also
learns it from the first uplink. Secrets stay as ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.
5. Save devices.json: it is hot-reloaded, no restart. The settings below are pushed on the next uplink.
TWO DEVICES: settings shared by every RAK3172 live once under "families"; sensor16 and sensor17 only
list what is theirs. sensor17 is the minimal case plus two overrides (5 C limit, 25 Hz).
Precedence, later wins: the type's built-in defaults, "defaults", "families", the device entry.
Everything except name and family is optional; the type's defaults fill the gaps.
temp_alarm_limit_c: alarm at or below this temperature (no correction on RUI3, tk_correction_c is 0).
motion_min_detections: 1 = every detection alarms; 3 with motion_window_s 30 = 3 hits within 30 s.
circuit_mode level: the switch state is in every heartbeat, so open fires and closed clears.
frequency 10 means 10 Hz; for RUI3 it is sent as ODR index 2. Hz, wire codes and index:N all work.
application_id is set per device (not in "families"): devices of one type can sit in different ChirpStack applications.
